note: PR/issue #1005 only. Official accept of the Day-by-Day photo popover on iPhone and of video tiles returning to itinerary rows. After tapping the expand (size-toggle) button at 390px with real touch emulation, the popover stays fully inside the viewport and all three buttons stay visible and tappable; a touch-scroll gesture that starts outside the popover does not dismiss it. A Thing with a video shows a video tile in its Day-by-Day row; tapping it opens an inline <video controls playsinline> inside the viewport, and a scroll does not dismiss it. Copy/throwaway trips only; never write NYC 8CQX / trip 99.
